## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Vipākattika* ("Triad on Karmic Results" or "The Triad 'karmically resultant, etc.'") constitutes section 13.3 of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Catalog; SuttaCentral; Nyanatiloka 2007a]. In systematic Abhidhamma analysis, the *vipāka-ttika* forms the third of the twenty-two primary triads (*tika*) of the Abhidhamma mātikā, analyzing conditional relations among phenomena that are karmic results, those that produce karmic results, and those that are neither [Nyanatiloka 2007a; Nyanatiloka 2007b].

According to computational analysis by DharmaNexus, the text exhibits extensive internal text reuse across the Abhidhamma Piṭaka, sharing 1,748 matching passages with 109 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial textual overlaps occur with other treatments of the same triad or related conditional matrices within the *Paṭṭhāna*, notably the *Vipākattika* of *Paṭṭhāna* 1.4 (439 matches), the *Tika Hetuduka* (*Paṭṭhāna* 4.1), the *Hetuduka, Tika* (*Paṭṭhāna* 3.1), and combined sections such as *Paṭṭhāna* 16.27 (*Vipākattika, Hetuduka*) and *Paṭṭhāna* 11.2 (*Kusalattika, Vipākattika*) [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language matching, DharmaNexus automatically aligns several segments (such as §5.1_0) with technical terminological entries in the Sanskrit *Mahāvyutpatti*, reflecting shared Abhidharma vocabulary [DharmaNexus].
